# lodash.clonedeep v4.5.0

The [lodash](https://example.invalid/) method `_.cloneDeep` exported as a [Node.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:
```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash.clonedeep
```

In Node.js:
```js
var cloneDeep = require('lodash.clonedeep');
```

See the [documentation](https://example.invalid/docs#cloneDeep) or [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/4.5.0-npm-packages/lodash.clonedeep) for more details.
